name: sequential-binding-dsl
desired: A let-like user DSL allows a later initializer to reference the earlier introduced name. This is beyond the documented caller-scope contract.

name: repeated-result-do
desired: Repeat Result bindings, exposing successful payloads to the final body and short-circuiting errors.

name: wrapped-body-delegation
desired: An outer binding macro wraps the forwarded body in an ordinary block. Current docs promise whole-fragment forwarding only.

name: scale-single-32
desired: Compile and execute a fixed number of macro calls within the existing budgets; vary only their distribution across functions.
